title: Sparkly lighthouse
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- ground rock base -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="90" rx="30" ry="7" fill="#5B6B8C"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="26" ry="6" fill="#6B7B9C"/>
  
  <!-- lighthouse body - tapered tower -->
  <polygon points="38,28 42,22 58,22 62,28 58,85 42,85" fill="#E84C3D"/>
  <!-- white stripes -->
  <polygon points="40,40 60,40 59,52 41,52" fill="#F5F0E6"/>
  <polygon points="41,64 59,64 58,76 42,76" fill="#F5F0E6"/>
  <!-- stripe highlights -->
  <polygon points="40,40 60,40 59,44 41,44" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.5"/>
  <polygon points="41,64 59,64 58,68 42,68" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- tower shadow edge -->
  <polygon points="58,28 62,28 58,85 56,85" fill="#C0392B"/>
  
  <!-- lamp room / gallery -->
  <rect x="36" y="18" width="28" height="6" rx="2" fill="#3D4A63"/>
  <rect x="38" y="14" width="24" height="6" rx="2" fill="#F5C542"/>
  <!-- light glow -->
  <rect x="42" y="15" width="16" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFF7B0"/>
  
  <!-- roof -->
  <polygon points="50,4 34,14 66,14" fill="#2C3E50"/>
  <polygon points="50,4 34,14 46,14" fill="#3D5166"/>
  <!-- roof tip ball -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="4" r="2.5" fill="#F5C542"/>
  
  <!-- light beams -->
  <polygon points="38,16 18,10 18,14 38,18" fill="#FFF7B0" opacity="0.35"/>
  <polygon points="62,16 82,10 82,14 62,18" fill="#FFF7B0" opacity="0.35"/>
  
  <!-- window on tower -->
  <rect x="47" y="56" width="6" height="6" rx="3" fill="#2C3E50"/>
  <rect x="48" y="57" width="4" height="4" rx="2" fill="#F5C542"/>
  
  <!-- door -->
  <rect x="46" y="78" width="8" height="10" rx="4" fill="#3D4A63"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="83" r="1" fill="#F5C542"/>
  
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill="#FFF7B0">
    <!-- sparkle 1 top left -->
    <path d="M20,28 L22,24 L24,28 L22,32 Z" fill="#FFE066"/>
    <!-- sparkle 2 top right -->
    <path d="M76,20 L78,16 L80,20 L78,24 Z" fill="#FFE066"/>
    <!-- sparkle 3 left mid -->
    <path d="M15,55 L17,51 L19,55 L17,59 Z" fill="#FFF7B0"/>
    <!-- sparkle 4 right mid -->
    <path d="M82,50 L84,46 L86,50 L84,54 Z" fill="#FFF7B0"/>
    <!-- sparkle 5 top center -->
    <path d="M50,2 L51,0 L52,2 L51,4 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <!-- sparkle 6 lower left -->
    <path d="M25,72 L26.5,69 L28,72 L26.5,75 Z" fill="#FFE066"/>
    <!-- sparkle 7 lower right -->
    <path d="M74,70 L75.5,67 L77,70 L75.5,73 Z" fill="#FFE066"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- small dot sparkles -->
  <circle cx="12" cy="38" r="1.5" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="35" r="1.5" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="12" r="1.2" fill="#FFF7B0"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="8" r="1.2" fill="#FFF7B0"/>
  <circle cx="10" cy="65" r="1.2" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <circle cx="90" cy="65" r="1.2" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="92" r="1" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="92" r="1" fill="#FFE066"/>
</svg>
